ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Safety CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain : OUR SCHOOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Home ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
